jobs.cancelling: Cancellation requested; waiting for cleanup. The task may finish before cancellation takes effect.
jobs.locked: This stage cannot be interrupted safely. Wait for completion.
jobs.explanation: Check the actual state before repeating an operation. Acknowledging a report only permits clearing its history; it does not repair data.
jobs.snapshot: This is a snapshot from the last check. Refresh after recovery or external changes.
jobs.server.1: Cancellation requested; waiting for a safe stop and cleanup
jobs.server.2: Wait for active tasks before checking recovery
jobs.server.3: Review the current state below. The interrupted operation has not been repeated.
jobs.server.4: A password change cannot be verified from stored credentials. Sign in or set a new password through Users.
jobs.server.5: Open home-folder settings. Recover an existing transfer before attempting another move; destination copies may have been retained.
jobs.server.6: Module transactions are recovered during agent startup. Review the installed version and enablement before installing again; upload credentials are not retained in the task.
jobs.server.7: Network watchdogs handle pending rollbacks. Review current connectivity and any pending confirmation in Network before applying a fresh configuration.
jobs.server.8: Do not restart package installation blindly. Review package status and refresh the update list; incomplete packages require repair before another upgrade.
jobs.server.9: Power actions are never replayed automatically. System availability alone does not prove whether the previous reboot completed.
jobs.server.10: Compare source and destination before retrying. A partial copy may exist; do not delete either automatically. Presence or size alone does not prove a complete copy.
jobs.server.11: Check array members and maintenance progress. Use the array pause/resume controls for an existing operation; do not recreate or reformat the array.
jobs.server.12: Inspect the actual partition/filesystem state. Formatting and resizing cannot be safely rolled back by rerunning the command. Back up available data before repair.
jobs.cancelledSafely: Cancelled at a safe point; inspect the result before starting another operation
